fragments.text: אֶתֵּן לְפוֹעֲלִי צֶדֶק. בְּיוֹם הֻנְבָּחַר מַעַשׂ לְהַבְדֵּק: גֵּאוּתוֹ מְאֹד נַעֲלָה. דֶּרֶךְ עַנְוְתוֹ לְפִי הַגְּדֻלָּה: הוּא אָדוֹן הָעוֹלָם. וּמִי הִקְשָׁה אֵלָיו וַיִּשְׁלָם: זוֹכֵר הוֹלֵךְ בְּתֹם. חוֹנֵן וְעוֹשֶׂה דִין יָתוֹם: טָהוֹר מָרוֹם וְנִשָּׂא. יָפֶה בְעִתּוֹ הַכֹּל עָשָׂה: כַּבִּיר לֹא יִמְאַס לְנִבְזֶה בְּעֵינָיו נִמְאָס: מְפֹאָר רוֹכֵב עֲרָבוֹת. נֹגַהּ נֶגְדּוֹ וְאֵשׁ לֶהָבוֹת: סוֹעֵף בְּחַרְבוֹת שְׁנוּנוֹת. עֲבוּר יְתוֹמִים וְאַלְמָנוֹת: פֹּעַל אָדָם יְשַׁלֵּם. צוּר פֶּה וּמֵשִׂים אִלֵּם: קוֹנֵה הַכֹּל בְּרַחֲמִים. רָם וּמַשְׁפִּיל רָמִים: שׁוֹפֵט יְצוּרָיו בַּחֲנִינָה. תָּמִים פֹּעַל אֵל אֱמוּנָה: שׁוֹפְטֵי אֶרֶץ תֹּהוּ. פַּחֲדוֹ יִבָּהֲלוּ וְיִתְמָהוּ: עוֹשֶׂה מִשְׁפַּט עַמּוֹ. וּתְחִלָּה מַקְדִּימָם מִפְּנֵי זַעְמוֹ: נְדִיבִים בְּדִקְדוּקָם יָחִילוּ. כַּאֲשֶׁר מִשְׁפָּטוֹ פָעָלוּ: רוֹאֶה כָל־תַעֲלוּמוֹת. יוֹשֵׁב בְּגָבְהֵי מְרוֹמוֹת: צוֹפֶה כָל נוֹלְדוֹת. חוֹפֵשׂ כָּל הָעֲתִידוֹת: קוֹרֵא הַדּוֹרוֹת מֵרֹאשׁ. חִקְרֵי לֵב לָתוּר וְלִדְרוֹשׁ: זוֹכֵר בְּרִית רִאשׁוֹנִים. קַיֵּם שְׁבוּעָה לְאַחֲרוֹנִים:

I praise the justice of my Creator on the day appointed for the examination of deeds. His majesty is great, but the way of His humility accords with His greatness. He is Lord of the world, who can resist Him and remain unharmed? He remembers the man who walks in uprightness, and graciously promotes the cause of the orphan. Pure, lofty and exalted, He has made everything harmoniously in its time. Although Almighty, He does not reject the man who in his own eyes is despised and rejected. Glorified, riding above the clouds, radiance is in front of Him and blazing fire. He rages with sharp swords on behalf of orphans and widows. He requites man according to his work. He shapes the mouth and also makes it dumb. Owner of all in compassion, He is lofty and lowers the lofty. He judges His creatures with clemency, perfect in action, God of faithfulness. Earthly judges are as nought, they are frightened through dread of Him and perplexed. He executes the judgment of His people, warning them first of His wrath. Noble ones tremble at the thought of their judgment, as to whether they have accomplished His law. He sees all that are hidden, He dwells in the loftiest heights. He perceives all that is happening, He explores all that is about to come. He summons the generations from the very beginning in order to search out and discover the thoughts of their hearts. O Thou who dost remember the covenant with those who came first, fulfil the promise to those who come last.
יִשְׁפֹּט תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק. וּלְאֻמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים. הָאֵל קָדוֹשׁ:
He judges the world in justice and nations in righteousness, God is holy.
יְיָ מֶלֶךְ יְיָ מָלָךְ יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
The Lord is King, the Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever.
אַדִּירֵי אֲיֻמָּה יַאֲדִירוּךָ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מֶלֶךְ:
בְּרוּאֵי בָרָק יְבָרְכוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מָלָךְ:
גִּבּוֹרֵי גֹבַהּ יַגְבִּירוּךָ בְקוֹל. יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ: יְיָ מֶלֶךְ יְיָ מָלָךְ יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
דּוֹהֲרֵי דוֹלְקִים יְדוֹבְבוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מֶלֶךְ:
הֲמוֹנֵי הֲמֻלָּה יְהַלְלוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מָלָךְ:
וְחַיִל וְחַיוֹת יָעִידוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ: יְיָ מֶלֶךְ יְיָ מָלָךְ יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
זוֹכְרֵי זְמִירוֹת יְזַמְּרוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מֶלֶךְ:
חַכְמֵי חִידוֹת יְחַפְּנוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מָלָךְ:
טַפְסְרֵי טְפוּחִים יְטַכְּסוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ: יְיָ מֶלֶךְ יְיָ מָלָךְ יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
יוֹרְשֵׁי יְקָרָה יְיַשְׁרוּךָ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מֶלֶךְ:
כַּבִּירֵי כֹחַ יְכַתְּרוּךָ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מָלָךְ:
לְבוּשֵׁי לַהֲבוֹת יְלַבְּנוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ: יְיָ מֶלֶךְ יְיָ מָלָךְ יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
מַטְעִימֵי מֶלֶל יְמַלְּלוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מֶלֶךְ:
נִצּוֹצֵי נֹגַהּ יְנַצְּחוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מָלָךְ:
שְׂרָפִים סוֹבְבִים יְסַלְסְלוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ: יְיָ מֶלֶךְ יְיָ מָלָךְ יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
עוֹרְכֵי עֹז יַעֲנוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מֶלֶךְ:
פַּחֲדֵי פְלָאֶיךָ יְפַצְּחוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מָלָךְ:
צִבְאוֹת צֹאנְךָ יְצַלְצְלוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ: יְיָ מֶלֶךְ יְיָ מָלָךְ יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
קְהִלּוֹת קֹדֶשׁ יַקְדִּישׁוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מֶלֶךְ:
רִבְבוֹת רְבָבָה יְרַנְּנוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מָלָךְ:
שְׁבִיבֵי שַׁלְהָבוֹת יְשַׁנְּנוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ: יְיָ מֶלֶךְ יְיָ מָלָךְ יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
סוֹמְכֵי תְהִלּוֹת יַתְמִידוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מֶלֶךְ:
תּוֹקְפֵי תִפְאַרְתֶּךָ יְתַמְּמוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מָלָךְ:
תְּמִימֵי תְעוּדָה יְתַנּוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ: יְיָ מֶלֶךְ יְיָ מָלָךְ יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
The mighty of the awe-inspiring people (Israel) swear allegiance aloud: The Lord is King.
Those formed in lightning bless Thee aloud: The Lord has reigned.
The strong and lofty raise their voice aloud: The Lord will reign. The Lord is King, the Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever.
The fiery in their haste utter aloud: The Lord is King.
The massed multitude praise aloud: The Lord has reigned.
And the hosts and the Hayoth testify aloud: The Lord will reign. The Lord is King, the Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever.
Chanters of psalms sing aloud: The Lord is King.
The wise in mysteries confirm aloud: The Lord has reigned.
Princes in heaven glorify aloud: The Lord will reign. The Lord is King, the Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever.
Heirs of the precious teaching affirm aloud: The Lord is King.
The mighty in strength pay homage aloud: The Lord has reigned.
Those enveloped in flames give thanks aloud: The Lord will reign. The Lord is King, the Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever.
They who speak pleasing words say aloud: The Lord is King.
They who sparkle with brilliance triumph aloud: The Lord has reigned.
The Seraphim around Him glorify aloud: The Lord will reign. The Lord is King, the Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever.
Those who classify the law respond aloud: The Lord is King.
Those in dread at Thy wonders utter aloud: The Lord has reigned.
The hosts of Thy flock let it ring out aloud: The Lord will reign. The Lord is King, the Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever.
Holy communities sanctify aloud: The Lord is King.
Myriads of myriads exult aloud: The Lord has reigned.
Those fashioned of flames repeat aloud: The Lord will reign. The Lord is King, the Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever.
Those who maintain praises say constantly aloud: The Lord is King.
Those who affirm Thy glory speak sincerely and aloud: The Lord has reigned.
The perfect in testimony relate aloud: The Lord will reign. The Lord is King, the Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever.

עוֹרְכֵי עֹז יַעֲנוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מֶלֶךְ:
פְּחוּדֵי פְלָאֶיךָ יְפַצְּחוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מָלָךְ:
צִבְאוֹת צֹאנְךָ יְצַלְצְלוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ: יְיָ מֶלֶךְ יְיָ מָלָךְ יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד:
קְהִלּוֹת קֹדֶשׁ יַקְדִּישׁוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מֶלֶךְ:
רִבְבוֹת רְבָבָה יְרַנְּנוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מָלָךְ:
שְׁבִיבֵי שַׁלְהָבוֹת יְשַׁנְּנוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ: יְיָ מֶלֶךְ יְיָ מָלָךְ יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד:
תּוֹמְכֵי תְהִלּוֹת יַתְמִידוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מֶלֶךְ:
תּוֹקְפֵי תִפְאַרְתֶּךָ יְתַמִּימוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ מָלָךְ:
תְּמִימֵי תְעוּדָה יְתַנּוּ בְקוֹל. יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ: יְיָ מֶלֶךְ יְיָ מָלָךְ יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד:
